tasks.prompt: Write a JavaScript function uniqueStable(values) that returns an array of the unique string or number values in first-occurrence order. Input is an array; do not mutate it. Empty input returns []. Return only JavaScript, using module.exports = function(values) { ... }; no Markdown or explanation.

Write a JavaScript function chunkArray(values, size) that splits an array into consecutive chunks of at most size elements. size is an integer; if size <= 0 return []. Do not mutate values. Empty input returns []. Return only JavaScript, using module.exports = function(values, size) { ... }; no Markdown or explanation.

Write a JavaScript function balancedBrackets(text) returning true when (), [] and {} brackets are correctly matched and nested; ignore all other characters. Empty text is balanced. Return only JavaScript, using module.exports = function(text) { ... }; no Markdown or explanation.
